name: StarHub Ltd

scam_info.sample: We will generally use the following types of links in our communications to customers: starhub.com/XXX for SMS communications. email.starhub.com/XXX for email communications. links.starhub.com/Wkp6/XXX for links directing customers to the My StarHub app.
scam_info.notes: (official) Explicit genuine-link patterns for SMS/email/app links; hotline 1633; report phishing/scam sites and messages impersonating StarHub to report-phish@starhub.com. Linked from site footer ('Clickable Links').

ScamSafe product page is an OutSystems JS app - curl returns only a loader shell (content not readable without JS). Per StarHub press release 18 Aug 2025 (corporate.starhub.com newsroom, HTTP 200): 'Developed with Gogolook ... ScamSafe caller automatically blocks known scam calls and filters suspicious SMS messages'; part of SafeHub+.

scam_info.sample: StarHub Launches ScamSafe: Where Scam Prevention is Made Simple | New mobile app proactively blocks scam calls and SMSes—free for everyone in Singapore for the first six months
scam_info.notes: Single press release (newsroom index not crawled). Whoscall/Gogolook engine behind ScamSafe.
Overseas-call blocking service (anti-scam), listed in personal.xml sitemap (lastmod 2025-11-13); page not fetched. Also /personal/how-to/what-is-cyber-security.html (lastmod 2026-06-24).
